description: Hand-written expectations for the pychivalry corpus (vscode-extension/src/test/fixtures/mock-ck3-mod, mirrored byte for byte by the numbered sections of `example mod/`). good: the engine diagnostics a good_* file must yield (empty unless the fixture itself contradicts the engine-derived truth; each such entry says why). bad: the engine diagnostics each bad_* file must at least yield, from the fixture's annotated intent; `phase4` names the intended defects the engine layers cannot see because they belong to a Phase 4 plug-in. Lines are 1-based.
